title: Four Words on the Face
label: ch:ka-face-words
canDo: I can name my eye, ear, nose and mouth in Kannada, and say which of the four the Dravidian family agrees on closely and which one splits.

payoff.summary: Name ಕಣ್ಣು, ಕಿವಿ, ಮೂಗು and ಬಾಯಿ, and finally explain ಬಾಯಿ — the word this book already used twice, unglossed, as proof of the v → b law behind ಬಾ and ಬರೆ.
